scripts.setup:git: git config filter.strip-secrets.clean "node scripts/strip-secrets.mjs" && git config filter.strip-secrets.smudge cat && git config filter.strip-secrets.required true
scripts.dev: npm run sync && shopify theme dev --path theme --store education-checkout-extensibility --theme-editor-sync
scripts.release: npm run sync && npm run lint && shopify theme push --path theme --store education-checkout-extensibility --unpublished
scripts.release:live: npm run pull:live && npm run sync && npm run lint && shopify theme push --path theme --store education-checkout-extensibility --live
scripts.pull:live: shopify theme pull --path theme --store education-checkout-extensibility --live --only config/settings_data.json --only "templates/*.json" --only "sections/*.json"
scripts.lint: npm run format:check && npm run check
